483-1339-1832-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
483-1339-1832-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

6991-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
6991-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-2738-4871-7316.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Rat King, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

277-1308-3129-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-1308-3129-4094-7942.description:

Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1379-2685-2919-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-2685-2919-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.

Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat.

1806-2060-5256-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

339-677-2511-4742.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

341-1170-1177-5078.description:

57-2751-4846-4927.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

57-283-3499-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-3499-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1303-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
1303-4050-4484-6896.description:

When Ebondeath enters, Necroduality triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2100-4258-6898.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.

Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Pest.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.

Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.

Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {W}.

Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Vesuvan Shapeshifter and another permanent you control.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.

You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.

Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.

Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.

Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instant and sorcery spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Mind Games by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate the Gilded Lotus token by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Mind Games from your graveyard with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Gilded Lotus.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping Gilded Lotus and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Activate the Gilded Lotus token by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other applicable permanent.
565-2909-5032-5116.notes: If you control another legendary permanent, this combo also produces "Infinite LTB" and "Infinite death triggers" by using the legend rule.

Cast Chromatic Star from your graveyard by paying {1}.

Brago does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least six artifacts.
An opponent cannot block Brago.

When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Akiri and create at least six Treasure tokens.

Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Akiri from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Reassembling Skeleton enters the battlefield, triggering Carnival of Souls, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B} to your mana pool.
